input.command: low=0; while true; do f=$(powershell -NoProfile -Command "[math]::Round((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory/1024)" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); if [ -n "$f" ]; then if [ "$f" -lt 2500 ] && [ $low -eq 0 ]; then echo "LOW RAM: ${f} MB free at $(date +%H:%M)"; low=1; elif [ "$f" -gt 3500 ] && [ $low -eq 1 ]; then echo "RAM ok again: ${f} MB free"; low=0; fi; fi; sleep 10; done
input.description: free RAM below 2.5 GB during eval
